activities.title: Welcome Back: From Garment to Figure
activities.summary: Students bridge from Week 4 garment-detail language into Week 5 figure and croquis language by recognizing one garment, one visible detail, and one new figure or pose cue on a single image.

en.title: Welcome Back: From Garment to Figure
en.summary: Look at the fashion figure and choose the words you can recognize.
en.instructions: Look at the figure. Choose the correct garment, detail, and first Week 5 figure word for each question.
success_criteria: I can recognize one familiar garment.
I can notice one visible garment detail.
I can identify one new Week 5 figure or pose word.

pt.title: Bem-vindo de volta: da roupa para a figura
pt.summary: Observe a figura de moda e escolha as palavras que você consegue reconhecer.
pt.instructions: Observe a figura. Escolha a roupa correta, um detalhe visível e a primeira palavra nova da Semana 5 em cada pergunta.
success_criteria: Eu consigo reconhecer uma roupa conhecida.
Eu consigo perceber um detalhe visível da roupa.
Eu consigo identificar uma nova palavra de figura ou pose da Semana 5.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the opener light and fast. Students should feel that they already know some of the visual language from Weeks 3 and 4 while noticing the new shift to figure, pose, and view.

input.prompt_en: Choose the review and preview words that match the figure image.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha as palavras de revisão e de apresentação que combinam com a imagem da figura.

items.label_en: Which garment is the figure wearing?
items.label_pt: Qual roupa a figura está vestindo?
Qual detalhe você consegue ver?

items.label_en: Which new Week 5 word matches the image?
items.label_pt: Qual nova palavra da Semana 5 combina com a imagem?
O que a figura está fazendo?

steps.title: Look at the figure
steps.student_action_en: Look at the figure and notice the garment, one detail, and the body position.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a figura e perceba a roupa, um detalhe e a posição do corpo.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students that Week 5 adds figure and pose language to the garment language they already know.

steps.title: Choose the review and preview words
steps.student_action_en: Choose the correct answer for each short question.
steps.student_action_pt: Escolha a resposta correta para cada pergunta curta.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the pace quick and supportive so the task feels like a bridge, not a test.

expected_output.description_en: Four quick recognition selections linking one figure image to a garment, a detail, and new figure language.
expected_output.description_pt: Quatro seleções rápidas de reconhecimento ligando uma imagem de figura a uma roupa, um detalhe e nova linguagem de figura.

completion_criteria_en: The student identifies one familiar garment.
The student notices one visible detail.
The student recognizes one new figure or pose word.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno identifica uma roupa conhecida.
O aluno percebe um detalhe visível.
O aluno reconhece uma nova palavra de figura ou pose.
checklist_en: I looked carefully at the image.
I used garment language from earlier weeks.
I noticed one new Week 5 word.
checklist_pt: Eu observei a imagem com atenção.
Eu usei linguagem de roupa de semanas anteriores.
Eu percebi uma nova palavra da Semana 5.
assessment.model_response_en: dress, short sleeves, figure, and standing
assessment.model_response_pt: vestido, mangas curtas, figura e em pé
common_errors: Choosing a fashion-studio tool instead of a garment word.
Focusing only on the clothing and missing the figure word.
feedback_prompts_en: Look again at the full image. Which answer names the figure and not the tool?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe novamente a imagem inteira. Qual resposta nomeia a figura e não a ferramenta?

support: Let students say the Portuguese support word quietly before choosing the English answer.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one full sentence such as The figure is standing.

extension_options: Name one more body-reference point you can see without using the options.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one image card with four short single-choice items. Save the selections only. Keep the experience quick and clearly positioned as a bridge from garment language to figure language.

activities.title: Body and Figure Vocabulary
activities.summary: Students learn the core Week 5 vocabulary by completing two main image-word matching sets, then using a short Portuguese bridge and one fill-blank sentence as support.

en.title: Body and Figure Vocabulary
en.summary: Match the body points and sketch words to the correct keyed images.
en.instructions: Match each visible key on the board to the correct English word. After the two main matching sets, use the Portuguese support and one short sentence for extra practice.
success_criteria: I can match body-reference points to English words.
I can match figure and sketch words to English words.
I can use Portuguese support when I need it without losing the English target.

pt.title: Vocabulário de corpo e figura
pt.summary: Relacione os pontos do corpo e as palavras de croqui às imagens com chave correta.
pt.instructions: Relacione cada chave visível do painel à palavra correta em inglês. Depois dos dois conjuntos principais de relação, use o apoio em português e uma frase curta como prática extra.
success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar pontos de referência do corpo a palavras em inglês.
Eu consigo relacionar palavras de figura e croqui a palavras em inglês.
Eu consigo usar apoio em português quando preciso sem perder o foco no inglês.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the main saved output focused on the two image-match sets. The Portuguese bridge and fill-blank sentence should come only after the main matching is complete.

input.prompt_en: Match the images to the correct English body and figure words.
input.prompt_pt: Relacione as imagens às palavras corretas em inglês sobre corpo e figura.

items.label_en: Match the body-reference points to keys A to F.
items.label_pt: Relacione os pontos de referência do corpo.

items.label_en: Match the figure and sketch words to keys A to F.
items.label_pt: Relacione as palavras de figura e croqui.

items.label_en: Match the Portuguese support to the English word.
items.label_pt: Relacione o apoio em português à palavra em inglês.
Complete a frase.

steps.title: Look at the diagrams
steps.student_action_en: Look carefully at the body-reference diagram and the figure-sketch board and notice the visible keys before you start matching.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe com atenção o diagrama de referência do corpo e o painel de figura e croqui e perceba as chaves visíveis antes de começar a relacionar.
steps.teacher_action: Explain that the main task is image-to-word matching and that the support items come after the core matching sets.

steps.title: Match the main vocabulary sets
steps.student_action_en: Match the visible keys on the body board and the figure-sketch board to the correct English words.
steps.student_action_pt: Relacione as chaves visíveis do painel do corpo e do painel de figura e croqui às palavras corretas em inglês.
steps.teacher_action: Monitor confusion points such as waist versus hip and outline versus silhouette.

steps.title: Use the support bridge
steps.student_action_en: Check a few Portuguese links and complete one short sentence.
steps.student_action_pt: Confira algumas relações com o português e complete uma frase curta.
steps.teacher_action: Use the bridge only as support after the main matching sets are done.

expected_output.description_en: Two saved image-word matching sets as the main scored output, followed by short Portuguese bridge and fill-blank support.
expected_output.description_pt: Dois conjuntos salvos de relação imagem-palavra como resultado principal avaliado, seguidos por apoio curto de ponte com o português e preenchimento de lacuna.
expected_output.length_or_format: 2 scored image-match sets as the main saved output, plus follow-up support practice

completion_criteria_en: The student completes the two main matching sets.
The student connects body and figure visuals to English words.
The student may use the Portuguese bridge and fill-blank item after the main matching task.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno completa os dois conjuntos principais de relação.
O aluno relaciona elementos visuais do corpo e da figura a palavras em inglês.
O aluno pode usar a ponte com o português e a lacuna depois da tarefa principal de relação.
checklist_en: I matched the main vocabulary images.
I checked the English words carefully.
I used the support items after the main task.
checklist_pt: Eu relacionei as imagens principais de vocabulário.
Eu conferi as palavras em inglês com atenção.
Eu usei os itens de apoio depois da tarefa principal.
assessment.model_response_en: A head, B neck, C shoulder, D waist, E hip, F knee; A figure, B croquis, C outline, D silhouette, E front view, and F side view
assessment.model_response_pt: A cabeça, B pescoço, C ombro, D cintura, E quadril, F joelho; A figura, B croqui, C contorno, D silhueta, E vista frontal e F vista lateral
common_errors: Confusing waist and hip because both are in the middle body area.
Confusing outline and silhouette because both describe shape.
feedback_prompts_en: Look again at the location and the meaning. Is the word naming a body point, a drawing type, or a shape idea?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe novamente a posição e o significado. A palavra nomeia um ponto do corpo, um tipo de desenho ou uma ideia de forma?

support: Let students complete the two main image-match sets before they see the Portuguese bridge items.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one short sentence after matching, such as The silhouette is long.

extension_options: Sort two or three matched words into body point, drawing word, or view word.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render the two image-match sets as the main scored and saved output. Both boards must show visible student-facing keys A to F, and the saved result should be the two A-F matching sets only. Show the Portuguese bridge and fill-blank sentence only after the matching sets are complete so the primary saved output remains matching.

activities.title: Label the Fashion Figure
activities.summary: Students practice figure labeling by matching body-reference words to explicit point keys on one front-view fashion figure.

en.title: Label the Fashion Figure
en.summary: Match the body words to the correct points on the figure.
en.instructions: Look at the front-view figure with point keys A to H. Match each body word to the correct point.
success_criteria: I can find the correct point on the fashion figure.
I can match body-reference words to visible keys.
I can use the figure image to check my answer.

pt.title: Rotule a figura de moda
pt.summary: Relacione as palavras do corpo aos pontos corretos da figura.
pt.instructions: Observe a figura em vista frontal com os pontos A até H. Relacione cada palavra do corpo ao ponto correto.
success_criteria: Eu consigo encontrar o ponto correto na figura de moda.
Eu consigo relacionar palavras de referência do corpo a chaves visíveis.
Eu consigo usar a imagem da figura para conferir minha resposta.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the task image-first. Students should use the visible A-H points rather than guessing from memory. Reinforce that the labels name reference points on a fashion figure, not general anatomy study.

input.prompt_en: Match each body-reference word to the correct point key on the figure.
input.prompt_pt: Relacione cada palavra de referência do corpo à chave de ponto correta na figura.

items.label_en: Match the body words to points A to H.
items.label_pt: Relacione as palavras do corpo aos pontos A até H.

steps.title: Look at the point keys
steps.student_action_en: Look at the figure and notice where points A to H are placed.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a figura e perceba onde os pontos A até H estão colocados.
steps.teacher_action: Point out that the same A-H keys appear in the task and the answer set.

steps.title: Match the labels
steps.student_action_en: Match each body-reference word to the correct point key.
steps.student_action_pt: Relacione cada palavra de referência do corpo ao ponto correto.
steps.teacher_action: Encourage students to use the visible image instead of trying to answer from memory.

steps.title: Check the figure again
steps.student_action_en: Look at the image again and check whether each point word really matches the body location.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a imagem novamente e confira se cada palavra realmente corresponde ao local do corpo.
steps.teacher_action: Use this last step to reinforce waist versus hip if needed.

expected_output.description_en: A saved set of 8 label matches connecting body-reference words to points A to H on one fashion figure.
expected_output.description_pt: Um conjunto salvo de 8 relações ligando palavras de referência do corpo aos pontos A até H em uma figura de moda.

completion_criteria_en: The student uses the visible point keys.
The student matches the main body-reference words to the correct locations.
The student checks the image again before finishing.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno usa as chaves de ponto visíveis.
O aluno relaciona as principais palavras de referência do corpo aos locais corretos.
O aluno observa a imagem novamente antes de terminar.
checklist_en: I looked at all the point keys.
I matched the body words carefully.
I checked the image again.
checklist_pt: Eu observei todas as chaves de ponto.
Eu relacionei as palavras do corpo com cuidado.
Eu conferi a imagem novamente.
assessment.model_response_en: A head, B neck, C shoulder, D arm, E waist, F hip, G leg, and H foot
assessment.model_response_pt: A cabeça, B pescoço, C ombro, D braço, E cintura, F quadril, G perna e H pé
common_errors: Confusing waist and hip because both are in the middle body area.
Looking too quickly and matching the shoulder to the arm.
feedback_prompts_en: Look at the exact point again. Is it at the top of the body, the side, or lower down?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe o ponto exato novamente. Ele fica na parte de cima do corpo, na lateral ou mais abaixo?

support: Reduce the first attempt to six key labels, then add the remaining two labels.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one sentence aloud such as Point E is the waist.

extension_options: Add one more sentence using a body-reference word from the image.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one explicit point-key labeling activity. The image must visibly show points A-H, and the saved output must be the A-H matching set. Do not use hidden coordinate logic or unlabeled click targets.

activities.title: Listen: Describe the Pose
activities.summary: Students listen to four short figure descriptions and identify pose, view, garment, and silhouette details using the shared four-figure gallery.

en.title: Listen: Describe the Pose
en.summary: Listen to the figure descriptions and choose the correct image or detail answer.
en.instructions: Look at images A to D. Listen to the audio and choose the correct image or detail answer for each question.
success_criteria: I can match a spoken description to the correct figure image.
I can identify pose and view words in the audio.
I can hear one garment or silhouette detail.

pt.title: Escute: descreva a pose
pt.summary: Escute as descrições das figuras e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.
pt.instructions: Observe as imagens A até D. Escute o áudio e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto para cada pergunta.
success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar uma descrição falada à imagem correta da figura.
Eu consigo identificar palavras de pose e de vista no áudio.
Eu consigo ouvir um detalhe de roupa ou de silhueta.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the four-figure gallery visible while students listen. The audio, question labels, answer keys, and model response should all use the same image A-D mapping.

input.prompt_en: Listen to the audio and choose the correct image or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Escute o áudio e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.

items.label_pt: Qual imagem é o Número Um?

items.label_en: Which figure is in side view?
items.label_pt: Qual figura está em vista lateral?
O Número Três está caminhando.

items.label_en: Which figure has one hand on the hip?
items.label_pt: Qual figura está com uma mão no quadril?

items.label_en: Which figure is wearing a jacket and pants?
items.label_pt: Qual figura está vestindo jaqueta e calça?

steps.title: Look at the gallery
steps.student_action_en: Look at images A to D and notice the pose, view, and clothing in each one.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe as imagens A até D e perceba a pose, a vista e a roupa em cada uma.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students that the listening answers connect directly to the visible gallery, not to hidden information.

steps.title: Listen and choose
steps.student_action_en: Listen to the audio and choose the correct image or detail answer for each item.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute o áudio e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto em cada item.
steps.teacher_action: Allow replay and encourage students to listen for pose, view, and garment words.

steps.title: Check the image again
steps.student_action_en: Look at the gallery again and confirm why each answer matches the audio.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a galeria novamente e confirme por que cada resposta combina com o áudio.
steps.teacher_action: Use the final review to reinforce image A-D and the key listening phrases.

expected_output.description_en: Five listening selections identifying pose, view, and garment details from one audio clip using images A to D.
expected_output.description_pt: Cinco seleções de escuta identificando pose, vista e detalhes da roupa a partir de um áudio usando as imagens A até D.

completion_criteria_en: The student uses the shared four-figure gallery while listening.
The student identifies pose, view, and garment clues from the audio.
The student connects the spoken description to the correct image key.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno usa a galeria compartilhada de quatro figuras enquanto escuta.
O aluno identifica pistas de pose, vista e roupa no áudio.
O aluno relaciona a descrição falada à chave correta da imagem.
checklist_en: I looked at images A to D.
I listened for pose, view, and garment words.
I matched the audio to the image keys.
checklist_pt: Eu observei as imagens A até D.
Eu escutei palavras de pose, vista e roupa.
Eu relacionei o áudio às chaves das imagens.
assessment.model_response_en: Number One is image A. The side view is image B. Number Three is walking. The figure with one hand on the hip is image D. The figure wearing a jacket and pants is image B.
assessment.model_response_pt: O Número Um é a imagem A. A vista lateral é a imagem B. O Número Três está caminhando. A figura com uma mão no quadril é a imagem D. A figura que está vestindo jaqueta e calça é a imagem B.
common_errors: Confusing image A and image B because both figures are standing.
Hearing the garment but missing the view word.
feedback_prompts_en: Listen again for the view word and the garment together. Does the audio say front view, side view, dress, or jacket and pants?
feedback_prompts_pt: Escute novamente a palavra da vista e a roupa juntas. O áudio diz front view, side view, dress ou jacket and pants?

support: Preview the gallery and say the key pose words before the first play.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one full reason after checking, such as Image B is correct because it is in side view.

extension_options: Choose one image and say one more sentence about its pose or clothing.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one audio player plus the shared image A-D gallery. The app should allow replay, keep the image keys visible, and auto-check against the exact script-aligned answer key. Do not create or reference a separate transcript asset.

activities.title: Read: Sketch Captions
activities.summary: Students read four short sketch captions, match each one to the correct image in the shared four-figure gallery, and then answer one detail question.

en.title: Read: Sketch Captions
en.summary: Read the four short captions and match each one to the correct image.
en.instructions: Read the four short sketch captions. Match Caption A, B, C, and D to image A, B, C, or D, then answer the detail question.
success_criteria: I can match a short caption to the correct figure image.
I can identify pose, view, and garment words in reading.
I can find one detail answer in a short caption.

pt.title: Leia: legendas de croqui
pt.summary: Leia as quatro legendas curtas e relacione cada uma à imagem correta.
pt.instructions: Leia as quatro legendas curtas de croqui. Relacione as Legendas A, B, C e D à imagem A, B, C ou D e depois responda à pergunta de detalhe.
success_criteria: Eu consigo relacionar uma legenda curta à imagem correta da figura.
Eu consigo identificar palavras de pose, vista e roupa na leitura.
Eu consigo encontrar uma resposta de detalhe em uma legenda curta.

activities.teacher_instructions: Reuse the same image A-D gallery from the listening task. Keep the captions short and concrete so students focus on matching visible evidence to language.

input.prompt_en: Read the captions and choose the correct image or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Leia as legendas e escolha a imagem ou o detalhe correto.

items.label_en: Caption A: This is a front-view fashion figure. The figure is standing. She is wearing a simple dress with short sleeves. The hem is below the knee. Which image matches?
items.label_pt: Legenda A: This is a front-view fashion figure. The figure is standing. She is wearing a simple dress with short sleeves. The hem is below the knee. Qual imagem combina?

items.label_en: Caption B: This is a side-view sketch. The figure is wearing a jacket and pants. The pose is relaxed. Which image matches?
items.label_pt: Legenda B: This is a side-view sketch. The figure is wearing a jacket and pants. The pose is relaxed. Qual imagem combina?

items.label_en: Caption C: This is a walking croquis. The figure is wearing a blouse and a skirt. The silhouette is long and simple. Which image matches?
items.label_pt: Legenda C: This is a walking croquis. The figure is wearing a blouse and a skirt. The silhouette is long and simple. Qual imagem combina?

items.label_en: Caption D: This fashion figure is standing. One hand is on the hip. The figure is wearing a fitted top and wide pants. Which image matches?
items.label_pt: Legenda D: This fashion figure is standing. One hand is on the hip. The figure is wearing a fitted top and wide pants. Qual imagem combina?

items.label_en: Which caption says the silhouette is long and simple?
items.label_pt: Qual legenda diz que a silhueta é longa e simples?

steps.title: Read the gallery first
steps.student_action_en: Look at images A to D and notice the main pose, view, and clothing in each one.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe as imagens A até D e perceba a pose principal, a vista e a roupa em cada uma.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students that the reading task reuses the same gallery from listening.

steps.title: Read and match the captions
steps.student_action_en: Read all four captions and match each one to image A, B, C, or D before you answer the final detail question.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia as quatro legendas e relacione cada uma à imagem A, B, C ou D antes de responder à pergunta final de detalhe.
steps.teacher_action: Encourage students to look for evidence words such as front view, side view, walking, dress, jacket, one hand on the hip, and silhouette.

steps.title: Check the details
steps.student_action_en: Look back at the visible captions and confirm the final detail answer.
steps.student_action_pt: Volte às legendas visíveis e confirme a resposta final de detalhe.
steps.teacher_action: Use the last minute to reinforce that reading depends on matching words to visible evidence.

expected_output.description_en: Four caption-to-image matches plus one final reading-detail selection using the shared image A-D gallery.
expected_output.description_pt: Quatro relações entre legenda e imagem mais uma seleção final de detalhe de leitura usando a galeria compartilhada de imagens A até D.

completion_criteria_en: The student matches the captions to the visible gallery.
The student finds pose, view, or garment evidence in the short texts.
The student answers one final detail question from the visible captions.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno relaciona as legendas à galeria visível.
O aluno encontra evidências de pose, vista ou roupa nos textos curtos.
O aluno responde a uma pergunta final de detalhe a partir das legendas visíveis.
checklist_en: I looked at images A to D.
I matched the captions carefully.
I checked the final detail clue in the text.
checklist_pt: Eu observei as imagens A até D.
Eu relacionei as legendas com atenção.
Eu conferi a pista final de detalhe no texto.
assessment.model_response_en: Caption A matches image A. Caption B matches image B. Caption C matches image C. Caption D matches image D. Caption C says the silhouette is long and simple.
assessment.model_response_pt: A Legenda A combina com a imagem A. A Legenda B combina com a imagem B. A Legenda C combina com a imagem C. A Legenda D combina com a imagem D. A Legenda C diz que a silhueta é longa e simples.
common_errors: Matching the right garment but missing the view word.
Reading the caption too fast and missing walking, one hand on the hip, or silhouette.
feedback_prompts_en: Look again for the strongest clue. Is it the view, the pose, the garment, or the silhouette phrase?
feedback_prompts_pt: Observe novamente a pista mais forte. É a vista, a pose, a roupa ou a frase sobre a silhueta?

support: Let students underline one clue word in each caption before answering.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one extra sentence about why the image and the caption match.

extension_options: Choose one caption and rewrite one sentence using The figure is or The figure is wearing.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as four short visible caption cards plus the shared image A-D gallery. Save four caption-to-image selections and one final detail selection. Keep the visible image keys aligned with the listening task so students can transfer the same figure mapping across tasks.

activities.title: Phrase Practice: The Figure Is / The Figure Is Wearing
activities.summary: Students practice the core Week 5 description frames through controlled fill-blank completions focused on pose, view, garment, silhouette, outline, and hem language.

en.title: Phrase Practice: The Figure Is / The Figure Is Wearing
en.summary: Complete the short description frames with the correct words.
en.instructions: Use the word banks to complete each short sentence about the figure, the view, the garment, the silhouette, or the outline.
success_criteria: I can complete the main Week 5 sentence frames.
I can use The figure is and The figure is wearing correctly.
I can describe one simple visual feature in English.

pt.title: Prática de frases: The Figure Is / The Figure Is Wearing
pt.summary: Complete as frases curtas de descrição com as palavras corretas.
pt.instructions: Use os bancos de palavras para completar cada frase curta sobre a figura, a vista, a roupa, a silhueta ou o contorno.
success_criteria: Eu consigo completar as principais estruturas de frase da Semana 5.
Eu consigo usar The figure is e The figure is wearing corretamente.
Eu consigo descrever uma característica visual simples em inglês.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the main output clearly focused on fill-blank phrase completion. This activity should feel like controlled language support before the writing card, not a mixed grammar test.

input.prompt_en: Complete the short figure-description frames with the correct words.
input.prompt_pt: Complete as estruturas curtas de descrição da figura com as palavras corretas.

items.label_pt: Complete a frase sobre a pose.
Complete a frase sobre a vista.
Complete a frase sobre a roupa.
Complete a frase sobre a bainha.
Complete a frase sobre a silhueta.
Complete a frase sobre o contorno.

steps.title: Read the frames
steps.student_action_en: Read the sentence frames and notice what type of word each blank needs.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia as estruturas de frase e perceba que tipo de palavra cada lacuna precisa.
steps.teacher_action: Remind students that these are the same frames they will reuse in the writing card.

steps.title: Complete the blanks
steps.student_action_en: Use the word banks to complete each short sentence.
steps.student_action_pt: Use os bancos de palavras para completar cada frase curta.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the focus on controlled completion, not free writing.

steps.title: Check the pattern
steps.student_action_en: Read the completed phrases again and notice the full Week 5 pattern.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia novamente as frases completas e perceba o padrão completo da Semana 5.
steps.teacher_action: Use the final review to reinforce The figure is and The figure is wearing.

expected_output.description_pt: Seis completamentos controlados de estruturas de descrição da figura salvos como resultado principal avaliado.

The student uses pose, view, garment, and silhouette language accurately.
The student prepares for the structured writing card with reusable patterns.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno completa as principais estruturas da Semana 5.
O aluno usa com precisão linguagem de pose, vista, roupa e silhueta.
O aluno se prepara para o cartão de escrita estruturada com padrões reutilizáveis.
checklist_en: I completed all the short frames.
I used the Week 5 patterns carefully.
I am ready to use these frames in writing.

Eu usei os padrões da Semana 5 com cuidado.

Choosing a noun when the blank needs an adjective or a pose word.

challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one of the completed sentences aloud and change one word.

activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as a fill-blank activity with short word banks. The main saved output must be the six fill-blank completions. Keep any extra review elements out of the main scored path so the submission type stays clearly fill_blank.

activities.title: Fashion Figure Description Card
activities.summary: Students produce the main Week 5 artifact by choosing one fashion figure and completing a short structured description card with required sentence-frame lines and one optional challenge line.

en.title: Fashion Figure Description Card
en.summary: Choose one figure and complete a short description card in English.
en.instructions: Choose one figure from images A to D. Complete the required lines about the image type, pose, view, garment, one detail, and the silhouette. Add the challenge line only if you want extra practice.
success_criteria: I can complete the required description lines.
I can use The figure is and The figure is wearing correctly.
I can describe one visible figure or garment feature in simple English.
sentence_frames: This is a fashion figure / sketch / croquis.
The figure is standing / walking / sitting.
This is a front view / side view / back view.
Optional challenge: I like the pose because ___.

pt.title: Cartão de descrição da figura de moda
pt.summary: Escolha uma figura e complete um cartão curto de descrição em inglês.
pt.instructions: Escolha uma figura das imagens A até D. Complete as linhas obrigatórias sobre o tipo de imagem, a pose, a vista, a roupa, um detalhe e a silhueta. Acrescente a linha de desafio apenas se você quiser prática extra.
success_criteria: Eu consigo completar as linhas obrigatórias de descrição.
Eu consigo usar The figure is e The figure is wearing corretamente.
Eu consigo descrever uma característica visível da figura ou da roupa em inglês simples.
sentence_frames: This is a fashion figure / sketch / croquis.
The figure is standing / walking / sitting.
This is a front view / side view / back view.
Desafio opcional: I like the pose because ___.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the task structured and line-based. Do not turn it into a paragraph or a word-count task. Students should complete 5 to 6 required lines plus 1 optional challenge line only if ready.

input.prompt_en: Choose one figure from images A to D and complete the required description lines.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha uma figura das imagens A até D e complete as linhas obrigatórias de descrição.

items.label_pt: Escolha a imagem da sua figura.
Linha 1: Nomeie o tipo de imagem.
Linha 2: Descreva a pose.
Linha 3: Nomeie a vista.
Linha 4: Descreva a roupa.
Linha 5: Acrescente um detalhe.
Linha 6: Descreva a silhueta.
Linha de desafio opcional

steps.title: Choose one figure
steps.student_action_en: Look at images A to D and choose one figure to describe.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe as imagens A até D e escolha uma figura para descrever.
steps.teacher_action: Guide students toward a figure that matches their confidence level.

steps.title: Complete the required lines
steps.student_action_en: Complete the required sentence-frame lines about image type, pose, view, garment, one detail, and silhouette.
steps.student_action_pt: Complete as linhas obrigatórias com frases-modelo sobre tipo de imagem, pose, vista, roupa, um detalhe e silhueta.
steps.teacher_action: Keep the writing structured. Encourage students to finish one line at a time.

steps.title: Add the optional challenge only if ready
steps.student_action_en: Add the challenge line only if you want extra practice.
steps.student_action_pt: Acrescente a linha de desafio apenas se você quiser prática extra.
steps.teacher_action: Make it clear that the challenge line is optional, not required.

steps.title: Check and submit
steps.student_action_en: Read your lines again and submit the card for teacher review.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia suas linhas novamente e envie o cartão para revisão do professor.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to check The figure is and The figure is wearing before submission.

expected_output.description_en: A saved Fashion Figure Description Card with 5 to 6 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge line.
expected_output.description_pt: Um Cartão de Descrição da Figura de Moda salvo com 5 a 6 linhas obrigatórias de frases-modelo e 1 linha de desafio opcional.
expected_output.length_or_format: 5 to 6 required lines plus 1 optional challenge line

completion_criteria_en: The student completes the required description lines.
The student uses pose, view, garment, and silhouette language clearly.
The student may add the optional challenge line, but it is not required.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno completa as linhas obrigatórias de descrição.
O aluno usa com clareza linguagem de pose, vista, roupa e silhueta.
O aluno pode acrescentar a linha de desafio opcional, mas ela não é obrigatória.
checklist_en: The card names the image type.
The card includes pose and view.
The card includes the garment.
The card includes one visible detail.
The card includes a silhouette description.
The challenge line is optional only.
checklist_pt: O cartão nomeia o tipo de imagem.
O cartão inclui pose e vista.
O cartão inclui a roupa.
O cartão inclui um detalhe visível.
O cartão inclui uma descrição da silhueta.
A linha de desafio é apenas opcional.
assessment.model_response_en: This is a fashion figure. The figure is standing. This is a front view. The figure is wearing a simple dress. The garment has short sleeves. The silhouette is long and simple. Optional challenge: I like the pose because it is clear.
assessment.model_response_pt: Esta é uma figura de moda. A figura está em pé. Esta é uma vista frontal. A figura está vestindo um vestido simples. A roupa tem mangas curtas. A silhueta é longa e simples. Desafio opcional: Eu gosto da pose porque ela é clara.
common_errors: Writing The figure standing instead of The figure is standing.
Writing The figure is using a dress instead of The figure is wearing a dress.
Using the challenge line as if it were required.
Writing only a garment name without a full sentence frame.
feedback_prompts_en: Please add the missing be verb in one line.
Please change using to wearing for clothing.
Please make one detail line clearer.
Please revise one line and submit again.
feedback_prompts_pt: Por favor, acrescente o verbo be que está faltando em uma linha.
Por favor, troque using por wearing quando falar de roupa.
Por favor, deixe uma linha de detalhe mais clara.
Por favor, revise uma linha e envie novamente.

support: Let students complete exactly five core lines with a visible word bank and one model line.
challenge: Invite stronger learners to add the optional challenge line or use outline in the detail line.

extension_options: Turn one line from the card into a speaking note for the teacher session.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as a teacher-reviewed structured writing card with separate saved line fields, not a paragraph text box. Keep 5 to 6 lines required, 1 challenge line optional, and show the teacher the checklist, common errors, feedback prompts, and return-for-revision workflow.

activities.title: Review and Improve: Body Words and Adjective Order
activities.summary: Students review one common Week 5 sentence problem and save one corrected version they can transfer into the Fashion Figure Description Card.

en.title: Review and Improve: Body Words and Adjective Order
en.summary: Choose one correction card and write the improved sentence.
en.instructions: Choose one correction card, notice the problem, and write the corrected sentence clearly.
success_criteria: I can notice one common Week 5 sentence problem.
I can write one corrected sentence clearly.
I can use the correction to improve my description card.

pt.title: Revise e melhore: palavras do corpo e ordem dos adjetivos
pt.summary: Escolha um cartão de correção e escreva a frase melhorada.
pt.instructions: Escolha um cartão de correção, perceba o problema e escreva a frase corrigida com clareza.
success_criteria: Eu consigo perceber um problema comum de frase da Semana 5.
Eu consigo escrever uma frase corrigida com clareza.
Eu consigo usar a correção para melhorar meu cartão de descrição.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep one narrow correction target per card. The goal is transfer back into the Week 5 description card, not broad grammar explanation.

input.prompt_en: Choose one Week 5 sentence and write the corrected version.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha uma frase da Semana 5 e escreva a versão corrigida.

items.label_pt: Corrija a falta do verbo be.
Corrija a expressão de roupa.
items.incorrect_sentence: The figure is using a dress.
items.correct_sentence: The figure is wearing a dress.
accepted_answers: The figure is wearing a dress.

items.label_en: Correct the article in the view phrase.
items.label_pt: Corrija o artigo na expressão de vista.
Corrija a ordem dos adjetivos.
items.correct_sentence: The silhouette is long and simple.
accepted_answers: The silhouette is long and simple.

steps.title: Choose a correction card
steps.student_action_en: Read one incorrect sentence and notice the correction focus.
steps.student_action_pt: Leia uma frase incorreta e perceba o foco da correção.
steps.teacher_action: Name the four main targets clearly: missing is, wearing, article in front view, and adjective order.

steps.title: Write the corrected sentence
steps.student_action_en: Rewrite the sentence clearly and accurately.
steps.student_action_pt: Reescreva a frase com clareza e precisão.
steps.teacher_action: Ask students to compare the corrected sentence with their own writing card.

steps.title: Transfer the correction
steps.student_action_en: Check whether the same problem appears in your own description card.
steps.student_action_pt: Confira se o mesmo problema aparece no seu próprio cartão de descrição.
steps.teacher_action: Prompt students to fix the same issue in their card if needed.

expected_output.description_en: One corrected Week 5 sentence saved after review.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma frase corrigida da Semana 5 salva após a revisão.

completion_criteria_en: The student chooses one correction card.
The student writes the corrected sentence accurately.
The student checks for the same issue in personal writing.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno escolhe um cartão de correção.
O aluno escreve a frase corrigida com precisão.
O aluno verifica o mesmo problema na própria escrita.
checklist_en: I chose one correction card.
I wrote the corrected sentence.
I checked my own description card.
checklist_pt: Eu escolhi um cartão de correção.
Eu escrevi a frase corrigida.
Eu conferi meu próprio cartão de descrição.
assessment.model_response_en: The figure is wearing a dress.
assessment.model_response_pt: A figura está vestindo um vestido.
common_errors: Keeping the original mistake in the corrected sentence.
Fixing the word but forgetting the article or the verb.
feedback_prompts_en: Read the corrected model again. Which word or small grammar part changed?
feedback_prompts_pt: Leia o modelo corrigido novamente. Que palavra ou pequena parte gramatical mudou?

support: Limit the first attempt to two correction cards for students who need more support.
challenge: Ask stronger learners to explain the correction rule in simple English or Portuguese.

extension_options: Correct one more sentence from your own description card.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Render this as one small correction-card activity. Let the student choose one card, type or select the corrected version, and compare against accepted answers. Save one corrected sentence as the mini-revision artifact.

activities.title: Teacher Session: Describe a Sketch
activities.summary: Students use their Week 5 figure-description card to practice pronunciation, label body-reference points live, and describe one figure or sketch in short supported sentences.

en.title: Teacher Session: Describe a Sketch
en.summary: Use your card to describe one figure or sketch in short sentences.
en.instructions: Bring your Fashion Figure Description Card, practice the key words, and describe one figure or sketch in 4 to 6 short sentences.
success_criteria: I can name one figure or sketch clearly.
I can use pose, view, and garment language while speaking.
I can describe one visible feature with teacher support.
sentence_frames: This is a fashion figure / sketch / croquis.
The figure is standing / walking / sitting.
This is a front view / side view / back view.

pt.title: Sessão com o professor: descreva um croqui
pt.summary: Use o seu cartão para descrever uma figura ou um croqui em frases curtas.
pt.instructions: Leve o seu Cartão de Descrição da Figura de Moda, pratique as palavras principais e descreva uma figura ou um croqui em 4 a 6 frases curtas.
success_criteria: Eu consigo nomear uma figura ou um croqui com clareza.
Eu consigo usar linguagem de pose, vista e roupa ao falar.
Eu consigo descrever uma característica visível com apoio do professor.
sentence_frames: This is a fashion figure / sketch / croquis.
The figure is standing / walking / sitting.
This is a front view / side view / back view.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep this teacher-observed only. Do not record student audio. Focus on intelligibility, accurate Week 5 frames, and confidence with a short supported description rather than long performance.

input.prompt_en: Use your Fashion Figure Description Card to describe one figure or sketch in short sentences.
input.prompt_pt: Use o seu Cartão de Descrição da Figura de Moda para descrever uma figura ou um croqui em frases curtas.

items.label_en: Say 4 to 6 short sentences about one figure or sketch.
items.label_pt: Diga de 4 a 6 frases curtas sobre uma figura ou um croqui.

items.label_en: Include pose, view, garment, and one visible feature.
items.label_pt: Inclua pose, vista, roupa e uma característica visível.

steps.title: Pronunciation clinic
steps.student_action_en: Practice key Week 5 words such as figure, sketch, croquis, outline, silhouette, shoulder, waist, hip, and knee.
steps.student_action_pt: Pratique palavras importantes da Semana 5 como figure, sketch, croquis, outline, silhouette, shoulder, waist, hip e knee.
steps.teacher_action: Model the words slowly and clearly, especially croquis, silhouette, shoulder, and proportion.

steps.title: Label the figure live
steps.student_action_en: Look at the shared figure or gallery and say the main body-reference points.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe a figura compartilhada ou a galeria e diga os principais pontos de referência do corpo.
steps.teacher_action: Use quick pointing and naming before the full speaking turn.

steps.title: Describe one sketch
steps.student_action_en: Use your Week 5 card to describe one figure or sketch in 4 to 6 short sentences.
steps.student_action_pt: Use o seu cartão da Semana 5 para descrever uma figura ou um croqui em 4 a 6 frases curtas.
steps.teacher_action: Allow students to read from their card first, then invite a more natural second try when appropriate.

steps.title: Wrap up and preview
steps.student_action_en: Listen to classmates and prepare for next week’s focus on color, shape, and line.
steps.student_action_pt: Escute os colegas e prepare-se para o foco da próxima semana em cor, forma e linha.
steps.teacher_action: Close with one short review of The figure is, The figure is wearing, and the main Week 5 visual words.

expected_output.description_en: A short teacher-observed spoken description of one fashion figure or sketch using Week 5 sentence frames.
expected_output.description_pt: Uma descrição oral curta, observada pelo professor, de uma figura de moda ou croqui usando as estruturas da Semana 5.

completion_criteria_en: The student names one figure or sketch clearly.
The student uses pose, view, and garment language in short sentences.
The student adds at least one visible detail or design comment with support if needed.
completion_criteria_pt: O aluno nomeia com clareza uma figura ou um croqui.
O aluno usa linguagem de pose, vista e roupa em frases curtas.
O aluno acrescenta pelo menos um detalhe visível ou comentário de design com apoio, se necessário.
checklist_en: I practiced the Week 5 words.
I used my description card.
I described one figure or sketch in short sentences.
checklist_pt: Eu pratiquei as palavras da Semana 5.
Eu usei o meu cartão de descrição.
Eu descrevi uma figura ou um croqui em frases curtas.
assessment.model_response_en: This is a fashion figure. The figure is standing. This is a front view. The figure is wearing a simple dress. The garment has short sleeves. The silhouette is long and simple. I like the pose because it is clear.
assessment.model_response_pt: Esta é uma figura de moda. A figura está em pé. Esta é uma vista frontal. A figura está vestindo um vestido simples. A roupa tem mangas curtas. A silhueta é longa e simples. Eu gosto da pose porque ela é clara.
common_errors: Saying the garment only and skipping the pose or the view.
Using using instead of wearing while speaking.
Reading too quietly to be understood.
feedback_prompts_en: Can you add one pose or view sentence?
Can you say that again with is wearing?
Can you add one visible detail?
feedback_prompts_pt: Você pode acrescentar uma frase de pose ou de vista?
Você pode dizer novamente usando is wearing?
Você pode acrescentar um detalhe visível?

support: Allow students to read directly from the Fashion Figure Description Card in the first round.
challenge: Ask stronger learners one follow-up question about silhouette, pose, or garment shape.

extension_options: Add one more spoken sentence comparing two figures from the gallery.
activities.notes_for_app_design: Keep this as a teacher-observed speaking checkpoint with the shared figure gallery and the saved Week 5 description card visible on screen. Do not record or upload student audio. The app role is to display prompts, link to the writing artifact, and store teacher completion notes only.
